subject: !! URGENT !! Your Microsoft account will be DELETED in 24 hours
body:
Dear User,

We have detected suspicious activity on you're Microsoft account. If you do not verify within 24 HOURS your account and all your files will be permanently DELETED.

Verify your identity now to keep your access.

Microsoft Security Department

landing.alt: A fake sign-in page on micros0ft-support-center.com asking for password, phone and recovery email
